questions: What is exposure?
If exposure increases, does the effect always become stronger?
What is avoidance?
If avoidance works, are you safe?
What is a session?
When the session ends, is the connection gone?
What is recovery?
Once recovery finishes, is everything restored exactly as it was?
What is an assessment?
If the assessment is high, is that good news?
What is resistance?
If resistance falls, does everything start flowing?
What is reinforcement?
If reinforcement stops, does the behavior disappear?
What is screening?
If the screening is clear, are you in the clear?
What is monitoring?
If monitoring shows nothing, does that mean nothing is wrong?
What is an alliance?
If the alliance breaks, can progress continue?
What is validation?
If validation fails, is the response rejected?
What is memory?
If memory is lost, is the past gone?
What is a defense?
If a defense fails, does the threat get through?
What is trauma?
If trauma leaves no mark, was there no damage?
What is processing?
When processing ends, is the problem finished?
